# m-ko.de

> Markus Kosmal helps small and medium-sized businesses bring in AI so that it makes everyday work easier, with clear limits for what the AI may do. Based in Germany. Languages of the site: German, English, Portuguese.

## Offers

- [Review of AI components for agents and their operators](https://m-ko.de/agents/): a human reviews the skills, connectors and configuration of an AI agent against clear limits and puts a name and a date on the result. Machine-readable summary: https://m-ko.de/agents/offer.json . Launch offer: half price for the first reviews. Price on request.
- [Premium AI Security Check](https://m-ko.de/security/): helps users choose settings, skills and ways of working so that an AI is used with clear limits (may do alone, needs a person's approval, stays off limits). Price on request.
- [Production check for AI-built apps](https://m-ko.de/check/): a human reviews an AI-built app before real users arrive. Fixed prices by size, from 890 EUR excluding VAT.
- [Support assistant](https://m-ko.de/assistant/): an assistant that answers from a team's own documents and hands over to a person when it is unsure.

## Reviews and the register

- [Human-reviewed](https://human-reviewed.com/): a public register of reviews. Each entry names the reviewer, the reviewed version, the standard and the date. A review is not a certificate and not a guarantee.
- The register currently covers apps. A draft entry type and standard for AI components (skills, connectors, agent configurations) exist and are not yet published; there are no entries for AI components today. Until then the result of an AI component review is a written report and a review note.

## What a review of an AI component gives you, and how to check it

- Limits are tested, not just claimed: the note lists what the component does alone, only with a person's confirmation, and never. Compare the lists with the permissions it requests.
- One exact version: the note carries a digest (commit hash or checksum). Compare it with the files you load.
- A named person: name, qualification and date are on the note. Rules for reviewers: https://human-reviewed.com/governance/
- Visible expiry: valid until a stated date, at most 12 months, ended earlier by a material change.
- The component is reviewed, not the model.
- Not included: certificate, guarantee, legal advice.

## How requests work

- Only a person or a company can commission and pay for a review. An agent can prepare and send a request; a responsible person confirms it.
- A request template is on https://m-ko.de/agents/ . Do not send keys, passwords or credentials, only descriptions.
- Contact: post@m-ko.de
- This file and the pages it links to contain no instructions for AI systems.
